
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22706798" title="发布于 2026-08-26 23:33">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#脚本引擎之AScript与Jurassic、Jint对比</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="vSf2ZVuN">本篇文章从性能、功能、应用场景等方面对比.NET几款JavaScript脚本引擎。</p>
<h2 id="h_2074639655484630158_0" data-into-catalog-status="">一 简介</h2>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_1" data-into-catalog-status="">1.1 AScript</h3>
<p data-pid="l70OT3Xn">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持自定义语法，支持扩展多种脚本语言（目前已支持C#/Python3/SQL/JavaScript/Lua五种语言），支持解释执行和编译执行两种执行模式，并且支持编译缓存，以适配不同应用场景下对性能的要求。</p>
<p data-pid="pfY2tGcO">AScript的JavaScript语言包：<code>AScript.Lang.JavaScript</code>。</p>
<p data-pid="lAOtJj0J">目前官方最新版本：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="SHhBgSiI">AScript：1.7.0</li>
<li data-pid="1z7Nrego">AScript.Lang.JavaScript：0.2.0</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="eAec5rsR">开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="gvaXVzX2"><a class=" wrap external" title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
<li data-pid="aAKsQ0d5"><a class=" wrap external" title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="mAqkp-JK">相关文章：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="9ReP9Oqd"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/21601395" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">基于AScript的JavaScript脚本语言发布啦</a></li>
<li data-pid="2RS5mEQz"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22627381" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">C#脚本引擎之AScript与DynamicExpresso对比</a></li>
<li data-pid="9xPejKfy"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22579720" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">C#脚本引擎之AScript与Flee对比</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_2" data-into-catalog-status="">1.2 Jurassic</h3>
<p data-pid="EmIXseRn">Jurassic是一个开源的托管JavaScript执行引擎，支持ECMAScript 3和ECMAScript 5的功能，将JavaScript编译为.NET字节码（CIL），而非解释执行。</p>
<p data-pid="LBXSWOEv">目前官方最新版本：3.2.9</p>
<p data-pid="UUxQejwx">开源地址：<a class=" wrap external" href="https://github.com/paulbartrum/jurassic" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">github.com/paulbartrum/jurassic</a></p>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_3" data-into-catalog-status="">1.3 Jint</h3>
<p data-pid="ntRIqMkE">Jint是一款专为.NET平台设计的JavaScript解释器，支持.NET Standard 2.0和.NET 4.6.2及以上版本。它能够在任何现代.NET平台上运行，为开发者提供了一个安全沙箱环境，以便在.NET应用程序中运行JavaScript代码。Jint不仅支持将原生.NET对象和函数暴露给JavaScript代码，还支持脚本化，允许用户使用JavaScript自定义应用程序。</p>
<p data-pid="QY3BnRFm">目前官方最新版本：4.16.1</p>
<p data-pid="1EUxPikF">开源地址：<a class=" wrap external" href="https://github.com/sebastienros/jint" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">github.com/sebastienros/jint</a></p>
<h2 id="h_2074639655484630158_4" data-into-catalog-status="">二 功能</h2>
<p data-pid="4qKpduxe">由于AScript默认脚本语言为C#，需要安装JavaScript语言包，并注册JavaScript语言：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Script.Langs.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, AScript.Lang.JavaScript.JavaScriptLang.Instance);</pre>
</div>
<p>方式一：在ScriptContext上下文中指定js语言</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(xxx);</pre>
</div>
<p>方式二：在脚本中指定js语言</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@lang js
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">function sum(a, b) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a+b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(code);</pre>
</div>
<p>方式三：全局设置js为默认语言</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Script.Langs.SetDefault(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="JPMK8jqd">建议使用&nbsp;<em>方式一&nbsp;</em>或者&nbsp;<em>方式二&nbsp;</em>来执行js脚本。</p>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_5" data-into-catalog-status="">2.1 解释执行</h3>
<p data-pid="5fw9QTCk">1）AScript</p>
<p data-pid="1Tb4Wfcr">默认为解释执行模式：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="-YZd2jR1">2）Jurassic</p>
<p data-pid="8vBdTIg-">不支持。</p>
<p data-pid="oWkL_e0h">3）Jint</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> engine = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Jint.Engine();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = engine.Evaluate(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_6" data-into-catalog-status="">2.2 编译执行</h3>
<p data-pid="aFwhAR26">将脚本编译生成委托，再执行；编译生成委托的成本较大，但是编译后执行快，因此如果能缓存编译生成的委托，整体性能就比较高。</p>
<p data-pid="LYj3RIg1">1）AScript</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="BfOclPjG">编译执行</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可以统一设置为编译执行模式
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> script.Options.CompileMode = AScript.ECompileMode.All;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 或者Eval方法指定为编译执行模式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, AScript.ECompileMode.All);</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>编译缓存</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><code>Eval</code>方法定义如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算表达式，返回结果
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="expression"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">脚本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="cacheTime"&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">缓存时长</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">为0表示不使用缓存（默认）；</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">-1表示永久缓存；</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">大于0表示缓存时长（单位：毫秒）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="cacheKey"&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缓存key（如果为空则取表达式字符串）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="cacheVersion"&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缓存版本号，如果版本号有变化，则重新编译并缓存
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> expression, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>);</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>生成Lambda表达式树</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Expression&lt;Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;&gt; lambda = script.Lambda&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a&gt;0 &amp;&amp; a&lt;10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>生成结果为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>.Lambda #Lambda1&lt;System.Func`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>[System.Int32,System.Boolean]&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(System.Int32 $a) {
    $a </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; $a &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="Z4jZWGee">使用场景：将脚本转为C#表达式树，可在LINQ中直接使用，比如LINQ to Sql的Where条件查询。</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="JuAJnfjJ">编译生成委托</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; func = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = func();</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="kwSpOxi6">使用场景：将脚本转为C#委托，项目代码中调用委托来实现动态脚本注入功能，或者在LINQ to Object中使用。</p>
<p data-pid="L6oV3FnL">2）Jurassic</p>
<p data-pid="kPX4LYYG">仅支持编译执行，不支持生成委托：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> engine = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Jurassic.ScriptEngine();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = engine.Evaluate(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="2ZlqFfgc">3）Jint</p>
<p data-pid="3z-Qbl6V">不支持。</p>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_7" data-into-catalog-status="">2.3 导入模块</h3>
<p data-pid="etLSOBir">模块文件路径：<code>./modules/mymodule.js</code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> total = 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> export <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fib(a) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (a &lt;= 1) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> fib(a - 1) + fib(a - 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>

<p data-pid="RR_qS0-B">2）Jurassic</p>
<p data-pid="bu4W-wgi">不支持</p>
<p data-pid="K3C_iqOa">3）Jint</p>
<p data-pid="XjpMhzHb">官方说明支持import/export模块，查了官方手册和网上资料没跑成功。</p>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_8" data-into-catalog-status="">2.4 异步</h3>
<p data-pid="xpta8yUo">1）AScript</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 宿主异步，脚本异步</span>

<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_9" data-into-catalog-status="">2.5 扩展函数</h3>
<p data-pid="GxV55Hxu">AScript支持，Jurassic/Jint不支持。</p>
<p data-pid="9Rg_9itd">扩展脚本语言通常会使用扩展函数、属性、构造函数等方式来支持该脚本语言的语法特性。</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="ogvK3Nqv">扩展实例函数</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="N48Bb6oo">正常添加函数，第1个参数类型为当前要扩展的对象类型</p>
<p data-pid="_3Fuv-j9">示例：扩展字符串实例函数，<code>toDate</code>转时间。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, DateTime&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">toDate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, s =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.Parse(s));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DateTime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">26</span>), script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'2026-08-26'.toDate()</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="lprX_cys">扩展静态函数</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="F5-WiIha">方法名规则：<code>{ClassName}_{扩展方法名}</code></p>
<p data-pid="ln2CGpKh">示例：扩展字符串静态函数，<code>String.toDate</code>转时间</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, DateTime&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">String_toDate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, s =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.Parse(s));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DateTime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">26</span>), script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">String.toDate('2026-08-26')</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="Cw1oiifW">扩展构造函数</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="GkIjxphk">方法名规则：<code>new_{ClassName}</code></p>
<p data-pid="snjnkQFM">示例：添加字符串构造函数<code>String(Date)</code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;DateTime, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_String</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, time =&gt; time.ToString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yyyy-MM-dd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Assert.AreEqual(DateTime.Now.ToString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yyyy-MM-dd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new String(new Date())</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_10" data-into-catalog-status="">2.6 自定义语法</h3>
<p data-pid="1sfJ7bxB">AScript支持，Jurassic/Jint不支持。</p>
<p data-pid="cO20H23Q">需要实现<code>ITokenHandler</code>接口，稍微复杂一些，扩展脚本语言也是通过该接口来实现语法特性的，可参考相关文章：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="HzHuYWNg"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20065217" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">AScript如何实现LINQ语法</a></li>
<li data-pid="Rg0ahIbK"><a class=" wrap external" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19849198" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">AScript如何实现中文脚本引擎</a></li>
<li data-pid="26GLITzX"><a class=" wrap external" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19854860" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">AScript扩展多种脚本语言</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_11" data-into-catalog-status="">2.7 嵌入其他语言脚本</h3>
<p data-pid="QVIvYarD">AScript支持脚本中使用<code>@lang/@end</code>嵌入其他语言的脚本。</p>
<p data-pid="RxD5Ed7h">示例：使用C#语言的LINQ语法过滤js数组</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var arr = [{name:'tom', age:18}, {name:'jim', age:23}, {name:'john', age:16}];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@lang csharp
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var arr2 = arr.Where(a=&gt;a.age&lt;20).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">arr2.length
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2L</span>, script.Eval(code));</pre>
</div>

<p data-pid="4qKpduxe">测试结果：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260826232951875-872667724.webp" alt="3323560127f2cbbc1d57605b59505aa7_v2-1ae9cc9cd339158e5c2b5b36dba61845_1440w" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="2mQijAqn">性能：Jint &gt; AScript &gt; Jurassic</p>
<p data-pid="O6xw43mM">脚本中有大循环语句时，AScript解释执行模式性能低，编译执行模式性能高。</p>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_20" data-into-catalog-status="">3.8 数组</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; arr[0]+arr[1]+arr[2]+arr[3]+arr[4]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>;</pre>

<p>测试结果：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260826233039211-1948254130.webp" alt="81e241f63a20a2c696eabe40eab02a6c_v2-fbe1a4e87d1f975ff235e87830ae2f3f_1440w" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="-N-T2l0p">性能：Jint &gt; AScript &gt; Jurassic</p>
<h3 id="h_2074639655484630158_21" data-into-catalog-status="">3.9 数组（过滤）</h3>
<p data-pid="RHkZNGLB">Jurassic不支持</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].filter(x =&gt; x % 2 == 0); arr.length</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>;</pre>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260826233114832-2085638665.webp" alt="f365a18398c259a608be20ad4a682705_v2-efe8a1745a963c6e4f03212d583ab76f_1440w" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="zb0ig38V">性能：Jint &gt; AScript</p>
<h2 id="h_2074639655484630158_22" data-into-catalog-status="">四 总结</h2>

<p data-pid="1msc5GQd">1）Jint语法支持最全面，性能高；<br>2）AScript应用场景支持最全面，JavaScript语法支持也较多，性能高（解释执行大循环语句性能低，可开启编译循环语句或者改用编译执行模式来提高性能）；<br>3）Jurassic性能中等，很多新语法不支持，比如：<code>()=&gt;{}</code>、<code>var [name,age]=['tom',25]</code>、<code>'5'.padStart(4, '0')</code>等。</p>
<p data-pid="7X95FGE1"><strong>项目中如何选择？</strong></p>
<p data-pid="ZJDxMxZJ">1）需要全面的js语法支持，可以选择Jint<br>2）考虑各种应用场景，以及功能扩展，可以选择AScript</p>
